Definition: apparently a strengthening form of the base of G5424; to fence or inclose, i.e. (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence):--stop.
BiblicalUsage: Phrasso means to fence in, to stop, to close up, and it appears where mouths are shut. Paul says the boasting of his regions shall not be stopped, the heroes of faith stopped the mouths of lions, and the law speaks so that every mouth may be stopped and the world may become guilty before God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the stopped mouth is the end of every argument with God: the lions are silenced, the boasting stands, and the whole world is left guilty and without excuse.
